mesa_runner.model module¶

Model objects and lifecycle state for individual MESA runs.

This module defines:

  • ModelState, the run lifecycle enum.

  • Model, the in-memory representation of one model, including inlists, timestamps, identifiers, and disk snapshot metadata.

Model instances are the central objects passed between setup, run, grid, and persistence/status layers.

file_snapshot¶

Dictionary containing relative paths of files at model_path. Used to track changes between inlists at model_path and in Model.inlists and only set when work_setup.create_modeldir is called with this instance as an argument.

Type:

dict[str, str]

snapshot_at¶

datetime object to store at which moment a file_snapshot is taken. Only set when work_setup.create_modeldir is called with this instance as an argument.

Function that returns a dictionary containing all the LOGS directories specified in the inlists

that are part of Model.inlists.

Returns:

  • Dictionary with locations to LOGS directories and the associated inlists
